2610.05080.title: Tracing a Sparse Emotion-Control Circuit in LLM-Based Text-to-Speech
2610.05080.paper_summary: LLM-based text-to-speech (TTS) models can generate emotionally expressive speech, but how reference emotion is routed through the model and realized in decoded speech remains unclear. We introduce two emotion-sensitive metrics for matched neutral and emotional syntheses---a codec trajectory score and a late residual direction score---and use them to score activation-patching interventions. Under controlled matched-reference conditions, this analysis identifies a sparse source-to-readout component-level circuit: 23--27 attention heads and MLPs per emotion, roughly 5% of the components considered, recover or suppress 74--88% of the late emotion-readout shift on held-out cases. The circuit combines a shared component backbone with emotion-specific components; cross-emotion activation swaps reduce the target readout in 47 of 48 cases. In decoded speech, the same intervention produces consistent changes in pitch, energy, and spectral brightness over 24 matched pairs per emotion. A readout-matched residual-direction baseline produces only 17--27% of the intervention's pitch effect, showing that internal readout movement alone does not explain the decoded acoustic changes. These results trace a compact causal route from reference-derived prefix information to emotion-relevant properties of generated speech.
2610.05080.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於文本到語音 (TTS) 模型可以生成情感表達豐富的語音，但參考情感如何在模型中傳遞並體現在解碼語音中仍然不清楚。<lb/>我們引入了兩個情感敏感的指標，用於匹配中性和情感合成——編解碼軌跡分數和延遲殘差方向分數——並用它們來評分激活修補干預。<lb/>在受控的匹配參考條件下，這項分析識別出一個稀疏的源到讀出組件級電路：每種情感 23-27 個注意力頭和 MLP，約佔考慮組件的 5%，在保留案例中恢復或抑制 74-88% 的晚期情感讀出轉變。<lb/>該電路結合了共享組件骨架和情感特定組件；跨情感激活交換在 48 個案例中有 47 個減少了目標讀出。<lb/>在解碼語音中，相同的干預在每種情感的 24 對匹配樣本中產生了一致的音高、能量和光譜亮度變化。<lb/>一個讀出匹配的殘差方向基線僅產生了干預音高效果的 17-27%，顯示僅靠內部讀出運動無法解釋解碼的聲學變化。<lb/>這些結果描繪了一條從參考派生前綴信息到生成語音的情感相關特性的緊湊因果路徑。
